spans.text: auditory oddball task

description.value: Auditory oddball task used to elicit P300 (P3b). Participants heard frequent 1000-Hz tones and infrequent 2000-Hz tones.

instructions.value: Keep the eyes closed and press a button with the right hand as quickly as possible upon hearing the infrequent high-pitch tones.

stimuli.value: Auditory tones presented with a fixed interstimulus interval of 1500 ms; 1000-Hz frequent tones and 2000-Hz infrequent tones.
